deviations: Nav content follows the plan/design-reference seven-item model (Films/Séries/Livres/Docs + Bilan culturel/À propos/Me suivre). The Salon mobile drawer mock in the Hifi HTML shows an older 'Accueil' item; that was superseded by owner decision #3 (medium filters get their own routes), so it was not used.

The desktop rail vs mobile top bar is CSS-media-query driven (lg = 1024px). Under jsdom both render in the DOM, so nav labels appear in both the rail and the drawer; SC-4/SC-5 tests use getAllByRole and assert count > 0 rather than a single match.
Added an /archives route + ArchivesPage placeholder per the spec route table (not enumerated in the SC-5 acceptance criteria text but present in the spec table and plan scope).

Breakpoint px values (sm 480 / md 768 / lg 1024) chosen as mobile-first defaults; design-reference names sm/md/lg without exact px. Exposed as --bp-* tokens; the actual rail switch uses the lg literal (1024px) in the CSS module.

Review fix (typecheck): added @types/node ^22.7.4 to devDependencies and prepended 'node' to compilerOptions.types in tsconfig.json so the sc1/sc2 file-assertion tests (node:fs, node:path, __dirname) type-check; ran npm install to populate node_modules with @types/node (resolved 22.20.1).

Review fix (home link): Brand wordmark and mobile topbar wordmark now render as react-router Link to '/'. Brand accepts an onNavigate prop; the drawer brand passes closeDrawer so clicking the wordmark closes the drawer. Added text-decoration:none (and display:inline-block on .wordmark to preserve the stacked
layout) to .wordmark and .topbarWordmark in Layout.module.css to keep the visual unchanged. All changes confined to src/components/layout/**.
notes: Tests were written but not run per the implement stage contract (review runs typecheck+lint, test runs the suite).
node_modules is not installed; the tree was scaffolded from zero.
All Salon palette hexes live only in src/styles/tokens.css; grep confirms no palette hexes in src/components or src/pages.
